tagline: 理光便携相机，1989 年发布
description: 理光于1989年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度mechanical, 1/125 sec. (fixed speed)。感光度ISO 100 - 400 (DX-code system)The DX-code system on the S-30 is only capable of detecting ISO 400 films. All the other films are rated as an ISO 100 film., ISO 1000 (manual)。Single-point active autofocusing system, 3 focusing zones。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.对焦: Single-point active autofocusing system, 3 focusing zones
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean type, 0.53X, field of view 84%
specs.感光度: ISO 100 - 400 (DX-code system)The DX-code system on the S-30 is only capable of detecting ISO 400 films. All the other films are rated as an ISO 100 film., ISO 1000 (manual)
specs.闪光灯: activates by sliding flash switch, F4 (ISO 100 / 200), F8 (ISO 400), F11 (ISO 1000)
specs.英文简介: The S-30 is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Japanese manufacturer Ricoh in 1989.
